## Description

Fits Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH(1,1)) models to price returns to dynamically widen or narrow option/equity mean-reversion trading bands.

## Where it may fit

Clustered volatility regimes, choppy sideways markets with changing return variance.

## Vehicles

Options trading desks, systematic equity funds, volatility arbitrage funds.

## Required data

High-frequency or daily continuous returns, implied volatility surfaces, historical price series.

## Caveats

Parameters can destabilize during abrupt structural regime shocks (e.g., flash crashes) requiring periodic re-estimation.
